These '''cyborgs''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaled IV]], where they venerated a [[Battle droid/Legends|war robot]] known as [[ZIMM]]. [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|Xenoarchaeologists]] debated whether ZIMM had any relation to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot.<ref name="Despotica Part I">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>
